module: State and small helpers shared by the MCP tool modules (mcp/tools/*.lua). Loaded by `require('mcp/shared')`, therefore a singleton via the require cache (it is not an extension loaded by extensions.load in normal use). Contains the results of asynchronous calls (GE <-> vehicle VM / UI), the physics instability log and helpers to resolve the vehicle id and read beamng.log.
usage:
local shared = require('mcp/shared')
local vid = shared.argVehId({id = 12})   -- 12, or the player vehicle if id is absent
local text, eof = shared.readLogFrom(nil) -- eof = current size of the log
notes: readLogFrom opens `beamng.log` relative to the current directory (game folder / user folder depending on launch); returns nil if the file is not found.
instabilityLog is fed by mcp/tools/vehicle.lua (onInstabilityDetected hook, 50 entries max).

asyncResults.desc: Results of asynchronous round trips, keyed by type: `vue`, `ui`, `vehLua` (table vehId -> result), `ai`, `electrics`, `hydro`, `testConfigs`. Filled by the `mcp_tools._cb.*` callbacks, consumed by the next tool call.

instabilityLog.desc: List (max 50) of detected physics instabilities: {time, vid, jbeam}. The code comment wrongly says "async round-trip results" for this field: it is indeed the instability log.

vehIdProp.desc: JSON schema fragment reused by vehicle tools: {id = {type='integer', description='Vehicle id (default: current player vehicle)'}}.

argVehId.desc: Vehicle id taken from args.id, otherwise that of player 0's vehicle.

args.desc: Tool arguments; `id` field read with tonumber.

returns.desc: Vehicle id (can be -1 or invalid if there is no player vehicle).

vehData.desc: Returns the spawned vehicle's data packet (parts, config, files, ioCtx) via core_vehicle_manager.getVehicleData.

argModel.desc: Model taken from args.model, otherwise the JBeam file of the current player vehicle.

returns.desc: Model key, nil if there is neither argument nor player vehicle.

readLogFrom.desc: Reads beamng.log from byte `pos` to the end. With pos=nil, starts at the end (returns ""): used to measure the current size. If the file has shrunk (rotation, truncation), restarts from 0.

returns.desc: Text read (nil if the file could not be opened).
File size (end position) to reuse as the next `pos`.
